answer: Resist sybils with a bonded capability vine: each new identity must grow from a parent that already settled work, staking a nonrefundable bond into a shared forge that burns on slash. Peers only accept edges that carry recent attested output; orphan roots die. Attackers flooding a lagoon of fake accounts pay the bond per leaf plus lost earnings when slash cascades up the vine, so mass cloning costs linear capital and time, not free addresses.
